events.title: alert-log annotation: 2026-07-22 test pollution
events.detail: 49 entries in this log are pytest fixture output, not real operational alerts. They span 2026-07-22T17:19:48Z to 2026-07-22T22:13:56Z in 16 bursts, each burst one pytest invocation. Cause: the suite reached the real reporting.alerts.dispatch, whose FileChannel bound the production path as a signature default, so nothing redirected it. Fixed by the autouse isolate_alert_log conftest fixture plus a late-bound FileChannel path. Entries are RETAINED, not deleted; exclude them from ops statistics. Fixture tells: 'paper trend: 2 order(s) submitted, $200,000.00 notional' and 'paper trend aborted at (account)'.
